description.value: Valley Sunrise Fresh Foods is a fresh-focused supermarket serving the Chilliwack area of the Fraser Valley. For touring cyclists passing through this agricultural region, it represents a community grocery stop with access to fresh produce and provisions. The 'fresh foods' branding suggests an emphasis on perishables and local produce typical of the Fraser Valley.

The Facebook page URL was fetched but returned only a 'Temporarily Blocked' error page with no actual business content, making the website effectively unusable as an evidence source. All amenity and contact fields must therefore rely solely on the OSM tags, which confirm only that this is a supermarket selling groceries.
